## Convergence points

### Service-layer partial convergence: `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`
**`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`**

Created, updated, and deleted memo events all funnel here. It resolves the memo creator, loads user webhooks, builds the payload, sets `payload.URL = hook.Url`, and calls `webhook.PostAsync`.

Comment-created events use a separate loop in `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:30–45`) that also ends at `webhook.PostAsync`.

### Single convergence before HTTP delivery: `webhook.PostAsync`
**`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`**
